author: Soupfamily
title: Fun but very limited ways to advance
content: At the rate you accumulate coins (like 20/win), it takes winning WAY too many games to extend play in ONE game (at 900 coins!), then 1900 to extend same game further.  Basically, there is no way to accumulate enough coins to buy boosters, extend games, etc.  Purchasing boosters takes too many coins (> 1000 coins each).  Basically, no matter how good a player is, there’s really NO WAY to advance in this game without spending real $. There are no reference tutorials to explain how to get past each kind of lock. You get an explanation of the lock once and once only, the first time it is introduced.  There is no way to earn bonus coins (daily reward, X # of levels, etc.).  I like playing the game, but can’t afford it!  Maybe after you advance the player incentives with mature development.  Until then, you’ll only get short-term players, not committed.
